title: GCC chief condemns Iranian attacks on Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan as ‘war crimes’

snapshot.title: GCC chief condemns Iranian attacks on Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan as ‘war crimes’
snapshot.description: RIYADH: Gulf Cooperation Council Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi on Saturday condemned Iran’s recent attacks on Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan, describing the strikes on civilian infrastructure as “war crimes.” He also said Iran’s actions “constitute a highly dangerous escalation, a grave violation of international law and the United Nations charter, as well as war
